Company description: CAT (Generated via gemini-3.5-flash-lite)

Caterpillar Inc., traded under the ticker CAT, is the world's leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines, and diesel-electric locomotives. Operating primarily through its Construction Industries, Resource Industries, and Energy & Transportation segments, the company also provides financial services and robust aftermarket support through its global dealer network. 

The company's origins date back to 1925 with the merger of the C.L. Best Tractor Co. and the Holt Manufacturing Company, which had previously pioneered the development of track-type tractors used during World War I. Headquartered in Irving, Texas, Caterpillar has evolved over a century into an indispensable pillar of global infrastructure development, resource extraction, and energy production, renowned for its iconic yellow machinery and unwavering commitment to technological innovation and sustainability.
